## C11 Closed h300 root-method block

The final audited block has 33 accepted solutions, nine time-limited returns, seven native soft-memory-limit returns, seven job-memory-guard stops and four cancellations. Only one of three planned temporal blocks was submitted. Native soft memory and external job-cgroup limits have different scopes. Original generic error labels remain in the evidence; complete logs show memory-limit termination.
